title: An Act to Protect Access to Health Insurance Under the MaineCare Program

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to enact measures to address issues relating to a MaineCare recipient losing MaineCare coverage if the recipient's income increases above the income levels established for MaineCare eligibility.
